title: docs(pm): an entry-.d.ts byte-identity claim needs a positive control in the same block
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#5914

Three times in one day a PR justified "this re-export widened nothing" by reporting that a
package's entry `dist/index.d.ts` was byte-identical across the change. Nothing in the review
discipline told a reviewer that reading apart from a calibrated one. This lands the row that
does, in the review-evidence home — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md`.

## The rule as landed

Placed directly under the existing positive-control row (`测量类交付先看阳性对照`), of which it
is the specialization — the kinship is structural rather than spelled out, which is also how the
house's sibling idiom reads (`⛔ 零命中必须用确定存在的邻近词反查`: a negative reading needs a
positive control):

```
- **引 entry `.d.ts` 逐字节相同,必须同块带阳性对照**:该读数只判**名字集**(增删再导
  出名会移动 barrel 字节),对 barrel 已转发符号的**形状**恒无效 —— `export *` 与
  `export type { X } from` 都不复述形状。判据:同块点名**声明**该符号的模块那份移动了的
  产物,或本会移动它的具名探针;缺则记 INCONCLUSIVE。实测 2026-08-24(清 dist 与
  tsbuildinfo 的三腿重建):声明包 `dist/base.d.ts` 随探针移动又移回,转发文件与 entry
  barrel 三腿全同;同日三处误用。
```

## The name-set-vs-shape nuance a naive rule gets wrong

The gauge is not dead in general, and a rule that simply banned the phrase would red-flag sound
prose. Both halves are stated in the row, because only the pair is actionable:

- **Informative for NAME-SET claims.** Adding or removing a re-exported name moves the barrel's
  bytes. Released CHANGELOG prose already leans on exactly this, correctly.
- **Never informative for the SHAPE of a symbol the barrel already forwards.** Forwarding never
  restates a shape — `export *` and `export type { X } from '…'` alike. Only the module that
  *declares* the symbol can move.

So the required control is a **positive** one: name the declaring module's emitted file whose
hash DID move, or a named probe that would have moved it. Absent that, the reading is recorded
INCONCLUSIVE rather than counted as evidence — the same disposition the parent row already gives
a measurement whose control failed.

Measured demonstration carried into the row by date (2026-08-24), three rebuild legs each from a
cleared `dist/` and a cleared `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`: the declaring package's `dist/base.d.ts`
hash moved with the probe and moved back, while the forwarding file and the entry barrel stayed
byte-identical through all three legs.

## Cut ledger — net 0 lines, ceiling holds at zero headroom

The file is ratcheted at 84 lines with headroom 0, so the 6 added lines are paid by 6 cut. No
re-wrap line-buying: every cut is a consolidation whose content survives in a named home, and
each surviving home is *more* complete than the copy removed here.

| cut | lines | what was removed | surviving home |
|---|---|---|---|
| `闭合关键词两读` row compressed 5 → 2 | −3 | the parser facts (keyword list, negation-blindness, safe spellings, body-vs-commit dual source, mis-closed cards hidden from open-only filters) and the post-merge read as an action | facts: `references/platform-readings.md` §`闭合关键词解析(PR 正文写侧)` — carries the three measured boundaries this copy never had. Action: `references/landing-operations.md`, whose inventory-reconciliation paragraph is what actually caught a silent mis-close. What survives here is the reviewer-of-record duty the other two do not own: the pre-ready body scan, still named as the only human gate before merge. |
| `被取代 head 上的 run 永不重跑` row folded into the head-pinning row above it | −2 | a separate bullet for a clause that is the same discipline — pin the reading to the current head | same file, one row up: the `cancelled`-on-superseded-head clause is now the tail of `每个门禁读数先钉到 PR 的当前 head`, with the "burns a heavyweight cycle" half dropped and the load-bearing half (a rerun faithfully reproduces a defect the current head already fixed ⇒ a false red on a green PR) kept verbatim in substance. Expected-signature fact at `references/platform-readings.md`. |
| `Part of` 收口 row compressed 3 → 2 | −1 | the pointer's long form and the "下次巡检看到再说" restatement | `references/landing-operations.md`, whose `确认 MERGED 的同一动作` paragraph owns the action and comment requirements the row now points to. |

Line-byte budget respected: widest line in the file is 120 bytes, no line added or edited exceeds
it, and the file carries no table row (its `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin is 0), so the measured example
is compressed to the file's bullet idiom rather than tabulated. No issue numbers in the protocol
prose — provenance is carried by date.

## Gates — union derived mechanically, run after the final commit

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (repo assertion held against
this checkout's `origin`), derived from the change set vs merge base `96732b03a`. All readings are
on `308a9af55`, which is this branch's head and byte-identical to the worktree. Exit codes captured
before any pipe.

| gate | verdict line | exit |
|---|---|---|
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet` | `✓ …/review-checklist.md is 84 lines (ceiling 84; headroom 0).` and `✓ …/review-checklist.md: widest table row is 0 bytes (pin 0; headroom 0).` | 0 |
| `check:pm-skill-id-lint` | `✓ check-skill-id-lint: 23 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g).` | 0 |
| `check:pm-governed-prose` | `✓ check-governed-prose: 2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces … and claim no others.` | 0 |
| `check:skill-frame-sync` | `✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files` | 0 |
| `check:skill-frame-freshness` | `✓ check-skill-frame-freshness: the decision frame in this tree is current with origin/main (fetched just now).` | 0 |
| `check:pm-governed-merges` | `✓ check-governed-merges --self-test: 206 assertions …` | 0 |
| `check:doc-authoring` | `✓ doc authoring guard: 48 published skill files clean — no internal issue-id references.` | 0 |
| `check:agent-test-spelling` | `✓ check-agent-test-spelling: 0 violations — 391 file(s) …` | 0 |
| `check:required-contexts` | `✓ check-required-contexts: 6 required context name(s) pinned across 2 workflow(s) …` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` | same check via its `required-set-patrol.yml` entry point | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` | `✓ check:doc-formula-expressions: 22 record-scoped formula example(s) across 425 files / 1453 TS blocks judged clean by @objectstack/formula.` | 0 |

The last one first exited 1 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the workspace package @objectstack/formula
is not built`, which the gate itself declares is **not a measurement** ("Nothing was measured: this
gate exited before running a single check"). Built `@objectstack/formula` then `@objectstack/lint`
(`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=… --concurrency=2`, both exit 0) and re-ran for the real green
above. Recorded here rather than reported as a red, per the gate's own verdict text.

`check:pm-governed-prose` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` are not in the mechanically derived
nine; they were named in the dispatch and run anyway.

## Positive control on the ratchet — this PR's own claim, calibrated

The ceiling verdict above is a green on a file whose ceiling has zero headroom, so on its own it
cannot distinguish "the gate read this file and it fits" from "the gate never read this file". The
control, run from the committed state so the restore leg has a real reference:

- Probe appended (`PROBE-CONTROL-LINE-ui5914`), **confirmed on disk** — `grep -c` = 1, file at 85
  lines — not inferred from an editor's exit code.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet` went **RED, exit 1**, naming this exact file:
  `✗ … /review-checklist.md is 85 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 84.`
- Restore leg `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH` (absolute path, `HEAD` named so the write does not
  come back out of a polluted index), **proven by state, not by exit code**: `git hash-object` of the
  worktree file equals the HEAD blob `78a592331c7373e998cef03640e9673c6eb5b11f` (non-empty, compared),
  probe hits back to 0, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ratchet green again, exit 0, at 84 lines.

## Scope

`.claude/**` only — releases nothing, so `skip-changeset` rather than a changeset (this repo's
route; the derivation's "once a changeset exists, 8 more families apply" note is the docs-only
branch of that same instruction). No `content/docs/releases/` change. No files outside the one
home.
